notes.title: 1.1.1 Balance and bug fix
notes.notes:
[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] The button as well as the function which manages the deletion of all saves have been removed, a new game system will be available for 1.2: "Lone Wolf". The characters thus created will not be linked to the rest of the account and will progress on their own, additional achievements will be added.
[*] Added information on purchasing spells to the tutorials section and added information on requirements if the spell is not learnable due to stats.
[*] When the player dies during a mission the mission ends and he cannot collect any rewards.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] The following buff spells have 50% movement speed instead of 0%: damage attenuation, indomitable shield, lightning shield, paper demon, lightning pet, rock pet, invulnerability, support spells Summon, Lightning Turret, Offensive Turret.
[*] The fire mine spell no longer has a cooldown.
[*] "Lightning mine", "cold mine", "volcanic eruption" and "ice storm" spells no longer have cast time.
[*] The following spells now have the cast category, their casting speeds have not changed: "Cold Shock", "Pure Energy Bolt", "Lightning Shock".
[*] Lightning Strike: Damage + 20%, cast time reduced from 0.5 to 0.4 seconds.
[*] Cone of Fire: Damage + 30%.
[*] Fire Shock: Damage area size -10%.
[*] Energy Beam no longer has a cooldown and no longer has a maximum cast time.
[*] Pillar of Frost, Meteor, and Ice Pike have the area damage spell category instead of projectile.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Mission monsters have the player level even without needing to use the "no weak monster" feature.
[*] Mission monsters correctly take into account the chosen difficulty level.
[*] Player-created wolf summons, correctly deal damage.
[*] The talent unlockable at 50 point that grants Absorb Shield after Energy Shield is destroyed performed correctly.
[*] Diffuse strike thrown with Strong strike is use correctly.
[*] The player regains all of their energy shield when resurrected.
[/list]

[*] Changed rendering for some grass which will now take into account the volumetric light, mainly visible on the terrain of the large bridge.
[*] The number of stack of items is correctly updated after a stack.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1 in progress 3/3
notes.notes:
1.1 should be released between [b]April 5 and 15[/b] and here is the work done in recent weeks with some new information.
I am only putting the most interesting changes here, an update note will be made when 1.1 is released.

If you missed the previous announcements, it's here: 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1145570/announcements/detail/3064105417956852230]1.1 in progress 1/3[/url]
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1145570/announcements/detail/3062982687973675677]1.1 in progress 2/3[/url]

[list]
[*] [b]Correction of the movement system[/b], I am talking here only of collisions and management of jumps. Many parameters have been revised and several features completely redone.
[*] [b]Talent tree modified[/b], navigation will be easier, visuals have been added on the talents that you have already learned, as well as on the talents that you have completed. The talent tree will be available from the 1st Ortharion Shard collected, allowing players to have more points to distribute.
[*] [b]22 new talents, the talent tree has therefore been reset.[/b]
[*] [b]Talent refund[/b], you will be able to refund your talent points for a small amount of gold with a single click.
[/list]

[url=https://ibb.co/ZJHnmr9][img]https://i.ibb.co/wLJ9sqt/Arbre-de-talent.png[/img][/url]


[list]
[*] Added 9 equipment spells.
[*] Added 14 runes.
[*] Added 16 gems.
[*] Added 9 spells.
[*] Added a consumable that will allow you to repair your items with low durability.
[*] Changed the visuals of 8 spells, mostly ice.
[*] 27 bug fixes, or all of what was known.
[*] A new object improvement interface, it will allow you to add or modify the powers, set and bonus level of your epic and legendary equipment.
[*] I also made many changes to the balances as well as additions for a better quality of play.
[/list]

[u]What remains to be done :[/u]

[list]
[*] Still 2 to 3 days of improvements.
[*] Complete the prototypes of the missions with offensive and defensive turrets.
[*] Settle the difficulties and rewards of the missions.
[*] Improve the decorations of the dungeon rooms, I will do a test on progressive discovery with a fog of war for the dungeons but I do not promise anything.
[/list]

Have fun

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.notes:
[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] Gold is now common to the account, the first load will erase the others given, [u]so start the game with your character who has the most gold[/u].
[*] Change of position and size of bow.
[*] Cooldown, cast time, mana use values ​​are visible as 0.00 instead of 0.0.
[*] The ghost in the desert does not target enemies and the enemies no longer attack him.
[*] In the parchment table it is possible to put blank parchments in the mystery parchment area with a click.
[*] All scrolls in the scroll upgrade interface are sent to your inventory when you close it.
[*] Changed the visual of Ortharion stones which are blue and with a smaller shard, to differentiate shards of Ortharion which remain smaller and red, in order to avoid confusion during quests.
[*] Purchasing items from merchants created duplicate items that were not visible, slowing the game if hundreds of items were purchased at the same time.
[*] Added a button to delete current quests, quests can then be retrieved again.
[*] Combat mode is reactivated on its own when you close a dialog window.
[*] The maximum elemental resistance statistic is visible on the character sheet.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] Divine Aura: "Damage reduction" no longer increases with leveling up and remains at 16%, damage bonus has been reduced by 20%.
[*] The infantryman support spell no longer gains damage bonus but power instead, making the spell a little stronger for low level but less powerful for higher level, blocking at maximum level decreased from 14% to 5%.
[*] Pet Support: Damage reduction taken decreased from 10% to 6.5% at max level, damage bonus decreased from 45% to 20%
[*] The price of procedural items, runes and gems sold by traders has been slightly increased and their chance of being of better quality has also increased.
[*] Powerful Summoning Rune (Epic) changed from + 15% damage / + 30% health to + 10% damage + 20% health.
[*] Runes that affect crit and critical damage are no longer visible on summons spells.
[*] Classic Summons have their attack and health which depends in part on the player's level, they have a little less damage and life before level 15 and up to 130% more health and 260% more attack at level 100.
[*] Summon attack and life gain reduced by a maximum of 20% at higher levels, low levels are hardly affected.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Weakening Aura no longer causes a problem with the camera.
[*] Duplicate items can no longer be found under certain conditions (normaly).
[*] The slope near Lumi in the land of the plains brigands is possible to use for the NPC
[*] Scrolls sent with a click in Parchment Destruction correctly account for the number of scrolls sent.
[*] Last damage is correctly displayed during enemy death.
[*] The weapons can again be improved at the blacksmith, jeweler, enchanting.
[*] Only weapons and armor can have a replacement at the jeweler.
[*] The fighting mage spell has the correct description in English.
[*] Fixed bugs that sometimes leveled enemies to level 1 (arena and campaign).
[*] Unlocking in the Mercenary Encampment lot correctly brings you back to the starting house.
[*] The occulus rift plugin has been removed which should prevent bugs for some players at launch, i don't have any problem with this so i can't be totaly sure.
[*] Damaging aura spells correctly break barrels and crates.
[*] Energy Shield and Mana Shield correctly take into account  damage reduction statistic for their calculations.
[*] Summoning runes that increase health, damage, duration work correctly, only bonus damage with categories summon can increase summon damage, the elemental bonus damage runes is not take into account yet.
[*] Your mage summons fireballs correctly throw at enemies and no longer hits themselves.
[/list]

[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix

notes.title: 0.8.7a Balancing - Bug fix
notes.notes:
In summary, this patch corrects all the minor bugs that are to my knowledge in the game, and adds more readability to spells. Some improvements still have to be made.
In-game progression speed for high level has been reduced.

The next 0.8.7b will be a quality improvement before moving on to 0.8.8 which will be the creations of the last bosses in the game in the arena.

There is just one bug that I haven't been able to fix, it is the movement and attack speed improvement with the spell "improved speed" which activates under certain very specific conditions.

[u]Adding content[/u]

[list]
[*] The Summon Blade spell is available and all the corresponding spells have been slightly modified so that the whole mecanism is understandable.
[/list]

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] Visual of "sword of justice" and "axe throwing" are improved.
[*] The maximum duration of improvement spells can be seen in the description.
[*] Added information on maximum spell duration: power, moving in the shadow, and gunner.
[*] The descriptive information of spells takes into account all the statistics that modify them, namely runes, talents, player statistics. The affected statics are: resource gain, resource usage, cooldowns, casting time and for some spells the maximum duration of the effect.
[*] The maximum camera distance changes to 14 meters instead of 18 which will allow slightly different dungeons that I will rework between 0.9 and 1.0
[*] Widening of the crafting interfaces and increase in the size of the texts which give information on their proper functioning.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] New progression calculation for difficulty: Level 10 is 30% harder, level 50 is 150% harder, level 100 is 300% harder which more closely matches player progress.
[*] Sword of Justice changed from 0 to 20 seconds cooldown, damage increased by 100%.
[*] Blade Storm mana cost changed from 7 to 32, damage increased by 100%.
[*] Fire Aura changed from 2 yards to 3 yards area of ​​effect.
[*] Pure Energy Bolt becomes a spell and therefore uses cast speed.
[*] Passive spell "Resistance to the elements" at maximum level increased from 30% to 18% resistance to fire, cold, lightning.
[*] Passive spell "Resistance to nature" at maximum level changed from 30% to 18% resistance to Physical, nature.
[*] State spell "Progressive Power" at maximum level decreased from 7% to 6% damage bonus per stack, number of stacks increased from 10 to 8.
[*] Chance of getting an item on monsters decreased from 36% to 30%.
[*] Chance of having a legendary item on gear decreased from 0.4% to 0.1%.
[*] Chance of having an Epic item on gear decreased from 2% to 1%.
[*] Slight increase in gold needed to upgrade non-passive spells.
[*] Strong price increase to improve passive spells, the total to reach level 25 is about 300% higher.
[*] Strong increase in the price of improvement of equipment rarity, especially between rare and epic rarity since this rarity allows to have new spells, the legendary being only a stat increase did not have a big increase .
[*] Slight price increase to add a new stat on low level items.
[*] Increased gem upgrade prices.
[*] Increased item change prices for Epic and Legendary.
[*] Slightly increased the price of the level upgrade, mainly for higher levels.
[*] Bonus level upgrade price increased, especially for later levels.
[*] Potions can be sold.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] The file that manages languages ​​is updated every day to avoid having any differences between my version and the one on steam.
[*] Correction of poorly explained or missing texts.
[*] The torso with the spells that improves Shadow Movement Dodge by 25% as well as the one with the increased clay armor duration work correctly.
[*] The "Shadow Enhancement" passive works correctly.
[*] The odds of finding better magic items based on difficulty apply to the entire game, not just high-level dungeons and the arena.
[*] Montaya and the powerful orcs correctly perform their special attacks and are therefore no longer blocked.
[*] Achievements are achievable on higher difficulty.
[*] The achievements are validated even in difficulty higher than the requested level.
[*] Since the achievements are unlocked, the player can move forward in the arena again (which is not over, I remind you)
[*] Enemies correctly attack your summons with ranged projectils.
[*] NPC projectiles can hit enemy NPCs.
[*] The player no longer dies between a procedural dungeon and arriving at the mercenary camp.
[*] Arena bosses give items based on player level.
[*] After loading a new session the Enchanter no longer shows bonus mana pool stat in place of life.
[*] Items purchased after being sold such as runes, gems, and quest items are correctly removed from the seller interface.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.7 Summon - Dual wielding - Bug fix
notes.notes:
A corrective patch will arrive in 2 days to correct some feedback I received recently.
Feel free to contact me if you have any suggestions, bug, or problem to understand how the game works if something is poorly explained.

Edit : The patch will arrive on Sunday I know that I will not have time to correct all the bugs and balances that have been reported to me.

[u]Adding content[/u]

[list]
[*] Added Polish, Italian and Japanese languages ( with google translate for now).
[*] Added 18 new spells, so 159/161 spells are available. Only the Sword Master and the bard spells are not yet available because more complicated to create than the others.
[*]Added chest with multiple tabs, increasing the total number of items that can be stored from 80 to 200 (5 * 40).
[*] Added ambidexterity and a new stat that decreases your damage by 50% when you are equipped with two weapons at the same time.
[*] The number of character saves has been increased from 5 to 20.
[*] Added new animations depending on the weapons you have equipped, I will wait until I have new animations before making any changes to some melee attacks such as slash and those added gonna be change too, it more a structural update than an animation update : future addition or changement gonna be much easier for me.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] The “action-mode” camera takes into account the player's rotation speed when casting a spell.
[*] The Skeleton Lord: Fire mage summons cooldown increased from 15 to 20 seconds. Healing Skeleton Summons cooldown changed from 12 to 20 seconds.
[*] Modd’s explosive nova has a cast time of 4 seconds instead of 5 seconds and the range is decreased from 30 yards to 20 yards, the shield that protects him during this time increased from 11000 to 12000 damage absorbed.
[/list]

[u]Bug Fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Putting the 3rd pillar on the 2nd pillar on the puzzle no longer crashes the game.
[*] Automatic rotation option: the camera is positioned correctly as it goes and no longer all at once.
[*] Desert boss no longer attacks you during the cutscene.
[*] When creating a character in the same game session: Achievements are correctly loaded, Action bar locks are correctly loaded, Equipment sets and epic spells are correctly removed.
[*] Fixed missing text, mostly on Epic and Legendary items.
[*] It is no longer possible to have the sprint bonus more than once.
[*] When launching the game for the first time several options are already checked such as damage display, action-combat mode, auto targeting, spell recording. You can turn them off in the options and I added them in the next game launch.
[*] The camera no longer fits into the walls in the summit dungeons.
[*] Escort characters follow you even after you are far away.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.5 new spells and set for items - Bug fix - Balancing
notes.notes:
[u]Adding content
[/u]
[list]
[*] 12 new spells for epic / legendary items.
[*] 3 new sets for epic / legendary items.
[/list]

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] The damage visible on the screen is in K if it is greater than 10,000 (10k) and 10M for 10,000,000
[/list]
[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] Mana gain per level for slash, magic projectile, rapid fire skill has been increased by 25%.
[*] Paper Demon: Damage bonus goes from 50% to 100% at maximum level, Cooldown 0 to 40 seconds, Mana used goes from 10 to 13.
[*] Strength of nature: Power increases from 10 to 20.

[*] Meteor: Cooldown goes from 12 to 0. The time to hit the ground is reduced by 50%, mana used goes from 40 to 60, casting time from 3 seconds to 2 seconds.

[*] Improved defense rune increased from 300 to 200 bonus defense.

[*] Talent for Energy Shield with 30 points : It no longer loses regeneration of total health points, bonus life points decreased from -2 to -3% per level.

[*] Chance of having legendary item reduced from 0.5% to 0.4%
[*] Chance of having epic item drops from 2.5% to 2%

[*] Divine difficulty: Life point of the monsters goes from +500% to +400%.

[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Fixed the mouse cursor remaining with a hand icon.
[*] The description of the difficulties in character creation displays the correct numbers.
[*] Fixed the healing calculation of monsters making them less powerful before level 80 and slightly more after.
[*] Correction of the calculation of the maximum resistances (ceiling at 75% and not 99%).
[*] Correction of the calculation of the damage suffered during a dodge, blocking as well as the information in the character window.
[*] Bonus Energy Shield is taken into account correctly when regenerating the Energy Shield.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented Lightning Pets from attacking.
[*] Fixed bug on second class spells that increase damage.
[*] Arena bosses are no longer present together in the arena.
[/list]

notes.title: 0.8.4c New runes - Improvement - bug fix
notes.notes:
The next update gonna be the 0.8.5 with new set, new items and bosses for the arena, probably in 10 days or so.

[u]Adding content[/u]

[list]
[*] The player can choose from a character window a damage specialization, this specialization influences the damage per second visual of the character sheet as well as the object comparison.
[*] Added 41 runes for a total of 105 runes currently available.
[/list]

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] The object comparison from the tooltip allows you to see in advance the changes in the dps as well as in the overall resistance.
[*] The energy and life bars are put side by side and no longer on the same bubble.
[*] Spell duration bonuses and spell damage bonuses are multiplicative and no longer additional.
[*] It is possible to pick up objects from the ground with the mouse.
[*] Ground objects can be inspected.
[*] The Pnj are recognized from further away depending on the position of your cursor, which makes targeting with single target and projectile spells easier.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] Reduction of certain statistics on high-level procedural equipment: Movement speed bonus, attack speed bonus, critical strike damage.
[*] Addition of resistance to elements on helmet, glove, legs, boots, torso.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] The runes found on the ground are correctly added to the rune bag.
[*] Fixed missing texts on some interfaces, mainly spells.
[*] It is no longer possible to add runes to spells that do not have the correct rank.
[*] The player's healing no longer benefits from the difficulty level.
[*] Change of visual on the meteor spell.
[*] It is no longer possible to retrieve items related to quests if the quest is not in progress.
[*] Monster groups no longer aggro from faraway.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.notes:
[u]Adding content[/u]

[list]
[*] Adding 7 Ortharion fragments, 2 achivement already available on steam.
[*] There are 6 procedural areas for high levels, they gonna be more improve later.
[*] The game areas like villas, towers of mages, catacomb, dungeon of the tops, dungeon of mountains are now semi-procedural (monsters, boss, levels, quest items will always be the same).
[/list]

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] Resurrections after death cost you 50% of your next experience gain.
[*] Resurrection zones are visible and only 1 zone can be activated. To be active you must approach it without being in combat.
[*] Addition of crate, destructible barrels on all the last terrains.
[*] Addition of patrol on all the last terrains.
[*] Some epic and legendary bosses have voices for agro and their combat phase changes.
[*] The locations where there was a fragment of Ortharion now have a chest.
[*] The camera is automatically placed in height at the start of a new fight, this new system can be disabled from the options menu. (Which should solve targeting problems for those who thought that playing with the camera at ground level was a good idea…).
[*] Allied Pnjs no longer block you while you move.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] The player's shots take into account his rotation speed.
[*] The double projectiles of the controller parasites are slower and follow the player every 1.7 seconds instead of 2 seconds.
[*] Modd shield absorbs 11,000 damage instead of 10,000. Power every 8 seconds instead of 10. Robustness every 6 seconds instead of 10. Mini explosion every 2 seconds instead of 3. Fire projectile every 3 seconds instead of 5 (they don't freeze anymore).
[*] Your time damage spells (such as burning, bleeding) and active spells with time damage (such as black hole, blizzard, volcanic eruption) no longer activate your passive spells and spells items that have a activation system.
[/list]

[u]Bug fix[/u]

[list]
[*] Elemental of nature and elemental of ice shot in front of them and no longer to the side.
[/list]

notes.title: Update to 0.9
notes.notes:
Each new update should take approximately 1 week.
Once the 0.9 releases the game will be on its final version and it will be released from its Early Access version 1 month later.
The date you see on the store page is therefore subject to change again.
I know it can be painful to see the date pushed back every time, but I do my best to improve it as much as possible, as quickly as possible.
Do not hesitate to give me feedback on improvements you would like to see during early access.
The game will continue to be improved after its release from Early Access.

Here are the next updates and what they will contain, the list is not exhaustive:

[u]0.81:[/u]

[list]

notes.title: Improvement of the camp and final version
notes.notes:
[i]This message is in two parts, first the update, then I will talk about all what will happen in the coming months so obviously with the final version of the game.[/i]

[h1]Update[/h1]

[h3]Adding content[/h3]

[url=https://ibb.co/WDwfCQc][img]https://i.ibb.co/cbHQqPN/Campement-Evolution0.png[/img][/url]
[url=https://ibb.co/DfMtmtt][img]https://i.ibb.co/KxsXBXX/Campement-Evolution1.png[/img][/url]

[b]Improvement of the mercenary camp available[/b], the camp is a prerequisite to evolve:

[u]The market[/u]

Each new level adds additional sellers, who are more and more specialized :

[list]
[*] Level 1 allows you to buy armor, weapons, potions.
[*] Level 2 allows you to buy runes, gems.
[*] Level 3 allows you to buy all types of weapons (sword, bow, dagger etc.), All type of armor (Necklace, belt, torso etc.), and random scrolls.
[/list]

[u]The blacksmith :[/u]

[list]
[*] Raise the level of the item, which also increases the level required.
[*] Decrease the required level of the object, without decreasing the level of the object.
[*] Give bonus levels to your item, which does not change the required level.
[/list]

[u]The enchanter :[/u]

[list]
[*] Change a single statistic on a piece of equipment, as many times as you want.
[*] Add a single statistic to a piece of equipment.
[*] Improve the rarity of a piece of equipment.
[/list]
   
[u]The jeweler :[/u]

[list]
[*] To completely change a piece of equipment, the piece is completely destroyed to create a new one with the same level and the same rarity.
[*] Improve your gems with a certain amount of luck.
[*] Add sockets to the equipment up to the maximum provided.
[/list]

Here with all these improvements the kind of item you can manage to have:

[url=https://ibb.co/T2JJVtp][img]https://i.ibb.co/sRcc0qk/Legendaire-Version-Final.png[/img][/url]

[h3]Improvement[/h3]

[list]
[*] When a new game is launched, the market is at level 1 as well as the camp.
[*] Improvement of the creation of slots, which reduces the loading time when the player has a lot of objects (equipment, storage chest, inventory, spell book).
[*] The description of the higher level differentiates between mana gains, mana gain per target, mana gain per target hit.
[*] The player no longer loses stamina if he runs up.
[/list]

[h3]Balancing[/h3]

[list]
[*] The boss mother of wolves is level 5 and no longer level 6.
[*] Bosses give on average 5 times more loot than normal monsters, the rarity will be improved later.
[*] The skeleton lord boss has gone from magic to rare, around 10% bonus in life, in damage, the skeletons he invokes his level 6 and no longer 5.
[*] It is no longer possible to recover fragments of the arena by cheating.
[*] Arena arrow throwers are simpler to perform.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fix :[/h3]

[list]
[*] The orcs are visible from a distance (it was invisible at more than 20 meters)
[*] The description of spell casting is correctly visible in English.
[*] The mother of wolves is susceptible to any attack.
[*] The name of spell restriction is in English and no longer in French.
[/list]

[h1]Current state of the game[/h1]

[list]
[*] The final version is always scheduled for April 20 normally, even if I think of leaving early access later, you will have my opinion on March 20 if I postpone the release.
[*] The first 2 terrains are in final version as well as the cave.
[*] There are then 6 other large fields and 3 indoor areas which will be improved thereafter, The Monsters are already present as well as the quests and fragments of Ortharion, but it lacks bosses and the balancing is not perfect .
[*] Moving ZQSD with orientation to the mouse repels a lot of playing, despite the change in the explanations, so I plan to make an orientation to the camera, like almost all Rpg actions of the moment. Give me your opinion !!
[/list]

The list below is what I plan for the release, changes may still occur. The structure is obviously much more complicated to set up, which is done 100%.

[list]
[*] Spells: 104/150
[*] Boss: 14/40
[*] Monsters: 33/60
[*] Gems: 31/31
[*] Runes 29 + 31 very soon / 100?
[*] Epic gear: 14/50
[*] Epic set: 1/13
[*] Legendary gear: 0/9, legendary pieces drop, but they have epic powers with additional stats.
[*] Legendary set 0/3, same.
[/list]

[h1]Final version and after[/h1]

[list]
[*] In addition to the content listed above there are two elements that will be added, the procedural dungeons and the arena.
[*] The arena offers a boss of level 30, 35, 40, 45 and 50. When you have killed one you can move on to the next.
[*] There will be 2 major variations of procedural dungeons for the release and I will add more later.
[*] I think the number of spells after the release will not change or really very little, on the other hand I plan to add many pieces of epic and legendary equipment that come to change the gameplay.
[*] There will be another major update to present the content of "end of game", the end of game arrives at level 25, but it is also at this time that you will unlock the legendary objects as well as the exploration semi-procedural.
[*] The number of 3D models for the main character's armor is quite poor, I plan to increase the number and the look of these new weapons and armors, but at the moment I can not promise anything, in the end this will depend on how the game is hosted.
[/list]

Thank you for reading all, don't forget to leave a positive comment on the steam page, this helps me to see the game better and more easily continue it once the final version is in place.

notes.title: Release date, Update and Roadmap
notes.notes:
In this message you will find information about the release date, the month update and the roadmap at the end. Don't hesitate to give me your feedback.

Here is what the game will contain on [u]April 20, 2020[/u]

[list]
[*] 12 terrains.
[*] No level limitation or progression.
[*] Improvement of your camp.
[*] Talent trees with more possibilities.
[*] Procedural dungeons ... if all goes well on the next test of the month.
[*] A bestiary of around 40+ classic monsters and as many bosses with several difficulty levels.
[*] 27 playable classes, each with at least 2 specific spells and 1 specific object.
[*] 150+ approximately spells, each spell having access to 5 runes, some runes being specific to certain spells.
[*] 2 epic and 1 legendary items for each type of equipment.
[*] 31+ gems for your equipment.
[/list]

[h1]Update :[/h1]

[u]Improvement[/u]

[list]
[*] Improvement of the interface.
[*] A sorting system has been added for the inventory
[*] Items in the inventory are slightly red if they cannot be used by the player.
[*] 5 types of success in place of a single large category for better readability.
[*] Visual and audio feedback added on many attacks.
[*] The spell book only has 1 area for spells with a scrollbar if the number of spells the player has is very large.
[*] Addition of an object separation window.
[*] Objects can be stacked manually
[/list]

[u]Adding content[/u]

[list]
[*] The player earns statistical points each level according to his class.
[*] The number of successes goes from 26 to 37
[*] Addition of 3 new bosses and improvement of 3 normal bosses.
[*] Gems go from 11 to 31
[*] The runes go from 21 to 29, other runes will be added.
[*] Storage chest that allows you to send items from one character to another.
[/list]

[u]Balancing[/u]

[list]
[*] Monsters gain experience.
[*] Procedural items sold at merchants have a price depending on the level of the player.
[*] Success no longer earns experience.
[*] Ice storm, damage + 300%, the launch range increases from 5 to 8.
[*] Shuriken: area increased from 5 to 2, damage -80%
[*] Energy Ray: Mana increased from 3 to 1 per second, -40% damage
[*] Defense penetration, physical penetration, fire, cold, lightning, nature have been completely withdrawn.
[*] Chance of having nothing by killing a monster 40% increased to 46%
[*] Chance of having weapon while killing monster drops from 14% to 10%
[*] Chance of having a rare weapon or armor increased from 21% to 12%
[*] Chance of having an epic weapon or armor increased from 2% to 3%
[*] Chance of having a legendary weapon or armor goes from 0.1% to 1% legendary equipment as much as epic may not be particularly powerful if luck is not on your side.
[*] Fire Shock: Cast time increased from 1 to 1.2. Movement speed 100% to 30%, cooldown 3 to 4 seconds, the "Spell" category has been added and the spell therefore uses the casting speed for the casting time and no longer the attack speed.
[*] Black hole of enemy nerves: damage, cooldown, total duration, a noise was added when the black hole is active.
[/list]

[u]IA[/u]

[list]
[*] If the line of fire is obstructed, the enemy advances towards the player.
[*] Non-player characters turn to the player before casting a spell.
[*] The group's agros are managed correctly.
[/list]

[u]Bugs[/u]

[list]
[*] The player is no longer in combat mode when enemies withdraw from combat.
[*] The rarity of epic and legendary items are saved correctly.
[*] The equipment no longer has 2 times the generation of lives, visible.
[*] Weapons can no longer have twice the power statistic.
[*] Correction of bug on the loading of certain objects.
[*] Gems that have defense bonuses are visible correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug that deleted backups when exiting from the main menu.
[*] Fixed a bug on death after launching the cutscene against the desert boss.
[*] Fixed a bug in creating procedural weapons on quests and purchases.
[*] Correction on the loading of several characters on the same game who had passive spells.
[*] Life by Stroke and Mana by Stroke are correctly taken into account.
[/list]

[h1]Roadmap[/h1]

[u]February 2020[/u]

[list]
[*] Added 10 powers of epic and legendary quality.
[*] Legendary object with set and spells.
[*] Added runes on many spells.
[*] Addition of a first procedural dungeon, perfectly functional but poor in decor.
[/list]

[u]March 2020[/u]

[list]
[*] Enemies and Boss will have some new powers
[*] Choice of second evolution classes available.
[*] Added 9 new achievements
[/list]

[u]April 2020[/u]

[list]
[*] Improvement of the camp.
[*] Balancing
[*] Final Release
[/list]

notes.title: New version of game available!
notes.notes:
The project itself has been completely reworked, it's mostly an internal job, but you will see some changes as for example :
[list]
[*] Graphic improvement
[*] Better fluidity in casting spells
[*] Better animations
[*] the spell structure has been revisited, they can now be cast from other spells.
[*] Less load time between scenes, the Database is loaded once at launch, then only the models 3D are loaded.
[*] The enemies can have different levels on the same ground and their level can also evolve.
[/list]

There are nevertheless some negatives on this version, but that I intend to correct thereafter:

[list]
[*] The visible effect system on the floor is no longer visible in the same way.
[*] The first desert terrain is not complete.
[*] Some elements are missing on the graphical options, like the qualities of the shadows.
[*] Some spells are less beautiful than before.
[/list]

I have for the moment removed the epic and legendary pieces of the game, the equipment will be available again soon with an overall object system but also with powers specific to certain parts.
The powers will be available to them later, between 1 to 3 months, with a system of creation of the particular spell to unlock them.
